style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, warm analog film grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling. No text, no captions, no inscriptions, no readable letters, no film stock branding, no Kodak or Portra labels, no frame numbers, no aspect ratio markers, no watermarks. No modern objects, no asphalt, no painted road markings, no vehicles, no cars, no motorcycles, no machinery. No human figures, no faces, no body parts, no hands. 1st-century Mediterranean Levantine setting only.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Parables of the Lost
images.concept: He welcomes sinners and eats with them — the provocation that launches three stories about finding
images.imageAlt: A full table set for a meal with an extra cup placed informally among the others, as if a late guest has been included
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, overhead close view of a simple table surface with several clay cups and torn bread in casual arrangement, one additional cup placed slightly outside the formal grouping as if placed there for someone unexpected, the whole arrangement informal and welcoming, warm amber afternoon light across the table, heavy warm analog film grain, muted warm palette, the extra cup the only element that speaks — the table that makes room, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Lost Sheep
images.concept: One left behind sought until found — the disproportionate joy over the one lost
images.imageAlt: A hillside of close-cropped dry grass with one patch of untouched longer grass in the far corner, unaccountably different
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a hillside of close-cropped dry pale grass extending across the frame, the whole surface uniform and flat, but in one corner of the image a small patch of longer ungrazed grass standing up unmowed and different, unreachable or overlooked, the difference in grass height the only event in the frame, warm raking afternoon light from the side, heavy film grain, muted dry gold and pale earth palette, the one different patch among the uniform — the one that matters, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: The Lost Coin
images.concept: Searching every corner with a lamp — the woman as God-figure, the found coin as occasion for heaven's joy
images.imageAlt: A small old coin catching lamplight in a dark corner of a stone floor, a lamp flame reflected in its face
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a dark stone floor with a small ancient coin lying in a corner where floor meets wall, the coin catching the warm light of a lamp nearby and reflecting a tiny bright point of amber in its tarnished face, the rest of the floor in deep shadow with only this small found brightness, heavy warm analog film grain in the dark stone, near-monochrome palette with only the reflected lamp warmth on the coin, the found thing illuminated in the dark — the search that ends here, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Prodigal Son's Return
images.concept: While he was still a long way off — the father running, the dead made alive
images.imageAlt: A long straight road across flat land converging at the horizon, a distant figure barely visible as a smudge, the near end empty
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a single uninterrupted landscape view of an ancient unpaved dusty footpath winding through dry summer grass and low ancient stone walls, the path narrow and worn smooth by foot travel, no road markings, no asphalt, no painted lines, no vehicles, late afternoon golden hour light, distant farmstead with smoke rising from a chimney barely visible at the horizon, no figure on the path, fine warm analog film grain, muted palette of dry grass, pale dust, golden hour, Kinfolk editorial restraint, single uninterrupted frame, no diptych, no panels, no split image, 16:9 landscape, the long dusty walk home toward warmth.

images.title: The Elder Son's Anger
images.concept: Outside the feast, unwilling to enter — obedience held as debt, joy refused at the door
images.imageAlt: Warm amber light and the sound of celebration implied by the lit windows of a house, the foreground outside in cool darkness
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, an exterior night view with the warm amber glow of lamplight visible through two small windows of a low stone building, the light inside suggesting warmth and activity, the ground outside the building in cool blue-gray darkness, a worn stone path leading from the darkness toward the lit doorway but the path empty and unused, heavy warm analog film grain in the outdoor darkness, muted palette of cool dark exterior and warm amber interior light, the outside refusing to come inside — the feast heard but not entered, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9
